digest.component_or_area: plan-review G7 criterion routing and rubric
propositions: G7 routing entry must change from advisory-posture at 0.95 threshold to blocking-posture at 0.85 threshold to enable plan-review blocking based on historical FP verification of 348 findings with zero clearly-incorrect findings at priority >= 0.85.

G7 rubric must add four rule sentences: abstain-on-unresolvable-parent, closed-parent-final-state handling with sibling-handoff carveout, one-finding-per-contradicted-parent-clause dedup pattern, and floor-kind guidance restricting automatic blocking to genuine contract contradictions and provably-required omissions.

Plan-review blocking for G7 operates via default_posture and block_threshold in routing configuration; kind scoping is enforced through existing divergence grading where contradicts_reality and omits_required_site floor impact at 0.85, while incomplete_enumeration caps at 0.55 and cannot reach blocking threshold.
Blocking-set pinned assertions in test_threshold_recalibration.py, test_impact_model_versioning.py, and test_plan_review_g7.py must be updated to reflect G7 at (0.85, blocking) posture.
